summary: 600 swaps in one week across only 6 tokens, with a near-uniform ~3.8 SOL clip and a two-minute median hold, several trades landing in the same second. That is an automated cycler, not a discretionary trader with an edge. Realized SOL out (1514) exceeds SOL back in (1065), and it never buys within 10 minutes of a launch, so there is no early-entry signal worth copying.
